import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace LonelyRunner

/-- A natural multiple of three has signed sixth residue zero or three; the
chosen residue records exactly whether it is divisible by six. -/
theorem exists_three_residue_mod_six (d : ℕ) (h3 : 3 ∣ d) :
    ∃ z ε : ℤ, (d : ℤ) = 6 * z + 3 * ε ∧
      (ε = 0 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (6 ∣ d ↔ ε = 0) := by
  by_cases h6 : 6 ∣ d
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h6
    refine ⟨k, 0, ?_, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    · rw [hk]
      norm_num
    · simp [h6]
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h3
    have hkodd : k % 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply h6
      refine ⟨k / 2, ?_⟩
      rw [hk]
      have hdecomp : k = 2 * (k / 2) + k % 2 := by omega
      rw [hdecomp, hzero]
      ring
    have hkmod : k % 2 = 1 := by
      have hlt : k % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      omega
    refine ⟨(k / 2 : ℤ), 1, ?_, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    · rw [hk]
      have hdecomp : k = 2 * (k / 2) + k % 2 := by omega
      rw [hdecomp, hkmod]
      push_cast
      ring
    · constructor
      · intro hd
        exact (h6 hd).elim
      · intro he
        norm_num at he

end LonelyRunner

      min (circleNorm (t * (a : ℝ))) (circleNorm (t * (b : ℝ))) = 0) :

      rw [← min_eq_right hba, hmin]
    apply dvd_of_circleNorm_nat_div_eq_zero (6 * c) b (by omega)
    have hphase : t * (b : ℝ) = -((b : ℝ) / ((6 * c : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [t]
      ring
    rw [hphase, circleNorm_neg]
    exact hb0
